answer: Each claim must carry a saffron pigment swatch mixed only from its own verified jobs, pressed into the tundra permafrost where the public ledger keeps the ice-core record of every mix. Three peers thaw one corner: a swatch mixed from borrowed jobs melts the wrong color and the claim drops with its 95 POA burned. One identity harvests one batch of pigment per epoch, and a batch is bound to its ledger line, so 10 clones need 10 harvests, 10 batches, 950 POA of fresh saffron, and a clone with no harvest of its own has nothing to mix.
